_: Direct-mode git watch (docs/how-it-works.md): asserted by Go (gitwatch_test.go) and Swift (GitWatchTests.swift); logs = `git diff-tree -m -r -z --name-only --no-commit-id` outputs parsed into names (NUL as \u0000); pins = what every git call of the watch has (args as given or as -c key=value; {null} = the null device), asserted by both

cases.name: commits, branch, tag
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: 2 new commit(s); new branches: feature; moved branches: main; new tags: v1; other refs changed: refs/stash

cases.name: protected paths committed
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: 1 new commit(s); moved branches: main
minigw: WARNING: the agent committed a protected path: .claude/settings.json, .envrc, .husky/pre-commit - review before git checkout, reset --hard, restore, stash pop or your next commit

cases.name: protected paths staged
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: 3 staged path(s)
minigw: WARNING: the agent staged a protected path: .envrc, .vscode/tasks.json - removed from the index for you (your files were not touched)

cases.name: merge in progress
lines: minigw: WARNING: a merge, cherry-pick or revert is in progress, started by the agent (MERGE_HEAD): finish it or cancel it (git merge --abort) after you have reviewed it

cases.name: already in progress at the start
lines: minigw: WARNING: a merge, cherry-pick or revert is in progress, started by the agent (REVERT_HEAD): finish it or cancel it (git merge --abort) after you have reviewed it

cases.name: checkout, deleted branch, detached
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: HEAD is detached; deleted refs: old

cases.name: partial start: index changed
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: the index changed

cases.name: partial start: protected path staged
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: the index changed
minigw: WARNING: the agent staged a protected path: .envrc - removed from the index for you (your files were not touched)

cases.name: partial start: protected path staged, index unchanged
replacement ref added (the replacement commit carries a protected path)
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: 1 new commit(s); other refs changed: refs/replace/aaaa
minigw: WARNING: the agent committed a protected path: .envrc - review before git checkout, reset --hard, restore, stash pop or your next commit
minigw: WARNING: the agent created or changed a replacement ref (aaaa): git shows other content than the real commits while it exists - review it, then git replace -d <name>

cases.name: replacement ref moved, no new commit
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: other refs changed: refs/replace/aaaa
minigw: WARNING: the agent created or changed a replacement ref (aaaa): git shows other content than the real commits while it exists - review it, then git replace -d <name>

cases.name: detached HEAD moved to a commit on no ref
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: detached HEAD moved; 1 new commit(s)
minigw: WARNING: the agent committed a protected path: .claude/settings.json - review before git checkout, reset --hard, restore, stash pop or your next commit

cases.name: the check was incomplete (limits)

end.head: main
incomplete: more than 200 new commits: only the first 200 were checked

lines: minigw: WARNING: the check of git in this folder is INCOMPLETE (more than 200 new commits: only the first 200 were checked; index not read in full): the absence of other warnings is not a clean result - review the repository before git checkout, reset --hard, restore, stash pop or your next commit

cases.name: an existing tag moved
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: moved tags: v1

cases.name: a ref name with a component that starts with a dash (arrives through packed-refs)
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: new branches: -x, ok/-y/z
minigw: WARNING: the agent created a ref with a name that starts with "-" (refs/heads/-x, refs/heads/ok/-y/z): a script of yours could take it for an option - review it, then git update-ref -d <name>

cases.name: a symbolic link committed as a regular file is named
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: 1 new commit(s); moved branches: main

minigw: WARNING: the agent changed the mode or type of link 120000->100644, run.sh 100644->100755 (120000 is a symbolic link, 100755 an executable file): review it before git checkout, reset --hard, restore, stash pop or your next commit

cases.name: a type change staged and not committed is named
lines: minigw: git in this folder, changed by the agent: 1 staged path(s)

minigw: WARNING: the agent changed the mode or type of link 120000->100644 (120000 is a symbolic link, 100755 an executable file): review it before git checkout, reset --hard, restore, stash pop or your next commit

logs.name: a quote and a newline in a name are raw, not C-quoted
names that look like a header or a commit id are names
a merge lists a name once for each parent
